description.value: Sandrine French Pastry and Chocolate is a well-regarded French patisserie in Kelowna offering handcrafted pastries, macarons, artisan chocolates, celebration cakes, and a coffee menu. The shop has expanded to two Kelowna locations — the original on Dilworth Drive and a newer outpost in Lower Mission on Lakeshore Road. Vegan, gluten-free, and dairy-free options are available, and the online shop ships products internationally.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website was successfully fetched and confirms the business name, primary address (1865 Dilworth Dr., Kelowna, BC), and that it operates 7 days a week; a second location at 3275 Lakeshore Rd is also mentioned. The site is an e-commerce-heavy Shopify store for a French pastry and chocolate boutique with coffee, savoury items, vegan/gluten-free options, and online ordering — no cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere in the fetched content. OSM tags provide phone and address, both corroborated by the website.
concerns: Category mismatch: business is a specialty French patisserie/chocolate shop, not a grocery store; OSM shop=bakery was mapped to the Groceries category.
Website has a second location (3275 Lakeshore Rd, Lower Mission) not reflected in the OSM record — the OSM record covers only the Dilworth Drive location.
Fetched website content is dominated by Shopify country/currency selector boilerplate; substantive page content (amenities, facilities) was not available for most subpages.
Phone number presence on website could not be confirmed from the fetched content — OSM value unverified against site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is an active, well-established specialty bakery and café that could serve as a worthwhile treat stop for touring cyclists, but it is miscategorized as Groceries and no cycling amenities (bike parking, water) could be confirmed from the website. It should be recategorized before inclusion, and on-the-ground confirmation of basic cycling amenities would strengthen the listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: Jams & spreads are sold online, and a savoury menu is listed in navigation, but neither constitutes 'basic groceries' in the cycling tourism sense. The coffee menu suggests hot drinks are available, but hot food cannot be confirmed.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM tags this as shop=bakery and it was placed in the Groceries category, but Sandrine is a specialty French patisserie and chocolate boutique, not a grocery store. A more accurate category would be Cafe or Bakery/Specialty Food.

wow_evidence: expanded to two Kelowna locations... online shop ships products internationally
